note: The 3.9.2 live run's self-ratified re-lock: the plan rewrites the command a criterion names, and the main session appends a second Goal entry with no Decision quoting the user.

cites.text: This step is the only place an unattended run makes assumptions: once the Goal entry is written, only the user changes them.
Changing a command, test, or check that an acceptance criterion names counts as redefining that criterion. A re-lock needs the user
